rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for forming text and for authoring a book, article, or other work.

example.english: I write a short story in my notebook.
example.traditional: 我喺簿仔度寫緊一篇短篇小說。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 bou6 zai2 dou6 se2 gan2 jat1 pin1 dyun2 pin1 siu2 syut3

rows.note: Use this construction when saying that you write a message or letter to a particular person.

example.english: I write a letter to Mum saying I'll be home late.
example.traditional: 我寫咗封信畀阿媽，話我會遲啲返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 se2 zo2 fung1 seon3 bei2 aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 wui5 ci4 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when information is explicitly stated or shown in writing.

example.english: I write clearly on the order form that shipping isn't included.
example.traditional: 我喺張單上面寫明唔包運費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 zoeng1 daan1 soeng6 min6 se2 ming4 m4 baau1 wan6 fai3

rows.note: Use this technical term when a computer or device records data to storage.

example.english: The device will automatically write data to the memory card.
example.traditional: 部機會自動將資料寫入記憶卡。
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 wui5 zi6 dung6 zoeng1 zi1 liu2 se2 jap6 gei3 jik1 kaat1
